free.name: WPEssential Cart Rules Inspector for WooCommerce
free.short_description: Inspect WooCommerce test carts, coupon eligibility, shipping, tax, and final total calculations.
free.description: Build safe diagnostic carts and inspect observable WooCommerce calculations. Actual feature listing must be verified before release.
installation: Upload and activate the WPEssential Cart Rules Inspector Free plugin.
Open WooCommerce > Cart Rules Inspector and run a test.

faq.question: Does it monitor customer checkouts?
faq.answer: No. It is an admin-side diagnostic tool and does not continuously record customer checkout traffic.

pro.name: WPEssential Cart Rules Inspector Pro for WooCommerce
pro.short_description: Extend the Free cart inspector with trace evidence, saved scenarios, comparisons, and diagnostics.
pro.description: Pro extends Free with supported evidence-based traces, saved scenarios and developer exports. Verify support and feature tests before release.
installation: Install and activate the separate Free plugin.
Upload and activate the Pro extension.
Verify supported adapter status before relying on rule-level attribution.

faq.question: Will every third-party pricing rule be identified?
faq.answer: No. Exact rule attribution requires tested adapters; unsupported sources are explicitly marked unknown or observed-only.
